paper_title: Quantum computation from dynamic automorphism codes
authors: Margarita Davydova; Nathanan Tantivasadakarn; Shankar Balasubramanian; David Aasen
statement: Therefore, is it possible to find interesting examples of dynamic automorphism codes that fault-tolerantly apply automorphisms that are not implementable by on-site transversal gates?
